{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''ornithologist''' was based out of<ref name="Hunting is for the Birds">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Hunting is for the Birds}}</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Hunting is for the Birds" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Hunting is for the Birds" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> they offered a substantial reward to anyone who brought them a rare [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-spotted variety of feathers belonging to the [[gibbit bird]]<ref name="Hunting is for the Birds" />&mdash;a type of [[Bird/Legends|avian]] that existed in a symbiotic relationship with [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]],<ref name="CSWE gibbit">{{CSWECite|I|340|gibbit bird}}</ref> large [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> originally [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]<ref name="TEA" /> and present throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing conflict, seeking to collect the reward, organized a rancor [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] with the help of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and eventually delivered a large quantity of yellow-spotted gibbit bird feathers to the ornithologist.<ref name="Hunting is for the Birds" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ornithologist was mentioned in a Treasure Hunting Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Hunting is for the Birds" /> In the real world, an [[Wikipedia:Ornithology|ornithologist]] is a scientist who studies [[Wikipedia:Bird|birds]].<ref name="Ornithologist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.environmentalscience.org/career/ornithologist|text=What is an Ornithologist?|work=[https://www.environmentalscience.org/ environmentalscience.org]|archivedate=20240521230557}}</ref>
